description: Creates a new list on a specified Trello board, with options to copy an existing list, set its position, initial state (archived/subscribed), and does not modify existing lists or move cards.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for creating a new list on a Trello board.

closed.description: Indicates whether the list should be created as closed (archived). Set to `true` for closed, or `false` for open.
closed.title: Closed

idBoard.description: The ID of the board to which the new list should be added. This is a required parameter.
idBoard.title: Id Board

idListSource.description: The ID of an existing list to copy when creating the new list. If provided, the new list will be a copy of this source list.
idListSource.title: Id List Source

name.description: The name for the new list. Must be a string with a length from 1 to 16384 characters. This is a required parameter.
name.title: Name

pos.description: The position of the new list on the board. Valid values are `top`, `bottom`, or a positive number (e.g., '1', '2.5').
pos.title: Pos

subscribed.description: Indicates whether the user creating the list should be automatically subscribed to it. Set to `true` to subscribe, or `false` otherwise.
subscribed.title: Subscribed

inputSchema.title: AddListsRequest

name: add_lists

AddListsResponse.description: Response schema for `AddLists`, containing the details of the newly created list.

creationMethod.description: The method by which the list was created
creationMethod.title: Creation Method

id.description: The unique identifier for the list (24-character hex string)
id.title: Id

idBoard.description: The ID of the board the list belongs to
idBoard.title: Id Board

limits.description: Object containing limit information for the list
limits.title: Limits

pos.description: The position of the list on the board
pos.title: Pos

softLimit.description: Soft limit for the number of cards in the list (can be null)
softLimit.title: Soft Limit

subscribed.description: Whether the current user is subscribed to the list
subscribed.title: Subscribed

AddListsResponse.title: AddListsResponse

disableAt.description: Threshold at which attachments will be disabled
disableAt.title: Disable At

warnAt.description: Threshold at which a warning will be shown
warnAt.title: Warn At

ListLimits.description: Object containing limit information for the list.
ListLimits.title: ListLimits
